notes.title: Atomic Heart 2 release date estimate, trailers, story, and gameplay
notes.notes:
When is the Atomic Heart 2 release date? Developer Mundfish is back, and wackier than ever. Atomic Heart was one of the most popular (and controversial) releases of 2023, presenting an alternate history 1950s Soviet Union dystopia that blends retrofuturism with surreal elements.

As one of the best FPS games, it has been quietly trucking along with a procession of DLC packs, and as we come to the end of its roadmap, Mundfish's Atomic Heart 2 announcement couldn't have come at a better time. To keep you up to speed, we've got all the latest news for the Atomic Heart 2 release date window, including gameplay trailers and story speculation.
